7:> Local MCP testing and mcpjam cloud: probing, debugging, OAuth, conformance, and hosted evals from your terminal
9:The `mcpjam` CLI is two invocations. Local MCP testing stays at the top level: inspect, debug, and test MCP servers from the com
mand line or CI (connectivity, OAuth, MCP Apps, tools/resources/prompts, protocol conformance). Most local commands are one-shot;
`mcpjam mcp` and `subscriptions listen` keep a process open. Account-bound commands live under `mcpjam cloud` and talk to your MCP
Jam account. There are no compatibility aliases for the old Cloud paths — see [Migrating to CLI 4.0](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/m
igration.md).
19:To convert existing promptfoo, pytest, Jest, or CSV tests, use the [MCP eval import skill](https://github.com/MCPJam/inspector/
tree/main/skills/mcpjam-eval-import).
22:npx skills add mcpjam/inspector --skill mcpjam-eval-import
25:To drive MCPJam's hosted eval tools — launch a run, poll it to a verdict, and triage a failure down to the step — use the [run
MCPJam evals skill](https://github.com/MCPJam/inspector/tree/main/skills/run-mcpjam-evals). This one is about running suites that
already exist, not writing them.
28:npx skills add mcpjam/inspector --skill run-mcpjam-evals
56:| [`test`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/local-evals) | Run an eval suite file locally (BYOK or MCPJam-hosted inference); never u
ploads | `test <file>` |
64:| [`apps`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/apps-conformance) | Validate MCP Apps metadata and resource wiring | `conformance`, `con
formance-suite` |
65:| [`oauth`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/oauth-conformance) | Test OAuth flows and conformance against an MCP server | `conforma
nce`, `conformance-suite`, `login`, `metadata`, `proxy` |
66:| [`protocol`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference) | MCP protocol conformance checks | `conformance`, `conformance-suite` |
76:Account-bound commands. Declare `--api-key` / `--api-url` on `mcpjam cloud` (before or after descendants). `mcpjam oauth login`
is MCP-server OAuth; `mcpjam cloud login` is your MCPJam account.
80:| [`cloud`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference#cloud-workspace) | Account, project link, and workspace | `login`, `logout`,
`whoami`, `link`, `status`, `organizations`, `projects`, `sessions` |
81:| [`cloud eval`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference#cloud-eval-commands) | Author and run eval suites in your hosted MCPJam
projects | `create`, `list`, `run`, `status` |
82:| [`cloud tunnel`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference#cloud-tunnel) | Expose a local MCP server through a public MCPJam tunn
el URL, registered as a server in your project | `tunnel --server <name> <url>`, `tunnel --server <name> -- <command>` |
83:| [`cloud clients`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference#cloud-clients-commands) | Manage clients in your hosted MCPJam projec
ts (`cloud hosts` is a deprecated alias) | `list`, `get`, `create`, `update`, `servers`, `duplicate`, `delete`, `templates` |
84:| [`cloud environments`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference#cloud-environments-commands) | Manage project environments — the
host + servers + pinned skills/plugins bundles eval suites and goals run against | `list`, `get`, `resolve`, `create`, `update`,
`archive`, `restore` |
85:| [`cloud images`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference#cloud-images-commands) | Manage custom Computer sandbox images (bluepr
ints) | `list`, `get`, `create`, `validate`, `edit`, `build`, `logs`, `use`, `reset`, `promote`, `delete` |
86:| [`cloud skills`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference#cloud-skills-commands) | List and read Cloud Skills in your hosted MCP
Jam projects — discover the skill IDs that `--compose-skill` and `--skill` require (read-only; authoring is in the app) | `list`,
`get` |
87:| [`cloud projects servers`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference#cloud-projects-servers-commands) | Connect MCP servers to a
project and manage pending connection requests | `connect`, `connect-status`, `connect-cancel` |
89:Also under `mcpjam cloud`: `goals` (`journeys` is a deprecated alias), `personas`, `swarms`, and `studies` (which publishes an
environment for outside testers and reads what they did; `scenarios` and `user-testing` are deprecated aliases for it). Full flag
tables are in the [command reference](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference.md).
93:`--api-key` and `--api-url` are declared on `mcpjam cloud` and work before or after descendants (`mcpjam cloud --api-key sk_… e
val list` and `mcpjam cloud eval list --api-key sk_…` are the same). Local commands, including hosted `readiness`, reject those fl
ags at the program root. Hosted `readiness` still takes leaf `--api-key`.
98:2. `MCPJAM_API_KEY` — same `sk_` rule. A legacy value in this env var is ignored (with a warning) so SDK eval reporting can sti
ll use it.
99:3. Stored OAuth from `mcpjam cloud login`
100:4. Missing — Cloud commands fail with login guidance before they hit the network (`mcpjam cloud status` reports `missing` inst
ead)
109:Every command that can contact MCPJam (it accepts `--api-url`, or it uploads results) decides its server when it starts, befor
e it contacts anything. An explicit `--api-url`, `MCPJAM_API_URL` or `MCPJAM_BASE_URL` that is not an `http(s)` URL, or that carri
es credentials, a query or a fragment, is a usage error (exit `2`), and so are the two variables naming different servers. The err
or masks credentials, a query and a fragment, and does not repeat a value that is not a URL. A saved login is only sent to its own
server: when it is the credential and the order picks another server, the command exits `3` before any request. `mcpjam cloud sta
tus` uses the same checks but stays network-free: it still emits the complete JSON report, sets `ok: false`, includes `credential.
valid` / `deployment.valid` plus an `error` string, and exits `1`. Missing credentials are informational (`credential.valid: null`
) and successful.
111:Successful Cloud commands print an audience line to stderr (`Using MCPJam Cloud as … · project: … · <apiUrl>`). `--quiet` supp
resses it. Machine-readable JSON stays on stdout. `cloud status` redacts API keys.
123:Empty `--project` or `MCPJAM_PROJECT` is a usage error. `MCPJAM_PROJECT_ID` does **not** select a Cloud CLI project (it is SDK
